description: This agent's spending limits as the owner set them: which money tools it may use, which assets, the cap per payment and per rolling 24 hours, allowed recipients, and when its permission expires. Check this before planning a payment. This MCP server enforces them before it signs (off-chain). When the agent's key is a Tempo access key, the result also has `onchain`: the owner's AccountKeychain authorization (expiry, the remaining periodic limit and call scopes), which the Tempo protocol enforces on every transaction whatever this server does. The vault contract itself does not know about limits.
name: gloam_get_limits
title: Spending limits
